name: Twos
description: Add selected text to Today or another list in Twos.

options.label: API key
options.description: Create a key with write:things permission. Sublist also needs write:lists. https://www.twosapp.com/settings/api-keys

options.label: Add to list
options.description: Choose Today, or Other… and enter an existing list's exact name or list ID. Tomorrow, yesterday, and YYYY-MM-DD also work.

options.label: Default thing type
options.description: Sublist creates a new list named from the selection and links it inside the destination.

options.label: Default tag
options.description: Optional: enter reading or #reading. A single # is added automatically. Use one tag without spaces; letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens are supported.

title: Add to Twos
